item.title: Registration is now open for Ensemble Nonlinear
item.description: Ensemble Nonlinear is RPI’s 21st century experiential musical performance ensemble. Ensemble Nonlinear allows students to participate as performers in the ensemble (ARTS 2600; 1 credit), as well as researchers, composers, and creatives (ARTS 4600/6600; 4 credits) building instruments and networked audio environments. To learn more, please join Dr. Rob Hamilton at a special information session on Friday October 30, at 4:00 pm in SAGE 2510.

item.description: The 2027 McKinney Writing Contest is open from November 1, 2026 through March 8, 2027 at 11:59pm. item.title: Order of the Engineer Ceremony
item.description: Date: Wednesday, October 28, 2026 7:00 PM - 9:00 PM - Come support our senior engineering students as they join the national Order of the Engineer. This is the 10th year the ceremony has been held at RPI. Students will pledge to act ethically in all aspects of their engineering careers. They will each receive a ring to remind them of their oath. All are invited to attend but you must have registered in order to participate. Refreshments will be served.

item.title: Computer Science Defense - Bao Pham - Memorization and Generalization in Generative Models: A Perspective From Energy-based Modeling and Associative Memory
item.description: Date: Friday, October 30, 2026 9:00 AM - 10:00 AM - Generative models now write working code, produce realistic images, and hold long conversations, yet the mechanisms behind their intelligence still evade our understanding. This thesis explores that puzzle through Associative Memory (AM), an idea that emerged from physics and its concept of energy, in which patterns are stored as energy minima and retrieved through attractor dynamics.

item.title: Handshake Training for Faculty & Staff
item.description: Are you hiring students for the spring semester? The Center for Career & Professional Development (CCPD) will host a virtual training for faculty and staff interested in posting their on-campus job or research opportunities in Handshake. The training will take place on Wednesday, November 4th from 11-11:45am. Learn about the job board system, writing strong postings, and see a demo of the platform. If you are interested in attending or have questions, please email Nicole Doran at stongn@rpi.edu.

item.title: Certifications & Skill Development in Percipio
item.description: This course introduces the tools available in Percipio to support growth through certifications and skill benchmarks. You’ll learn how to identify relevant certifications and use benchmark assessments to measure current knowledge. Perfect for employees and supervisors alike, this session will help you navigate the platform’s upskilling features and align learning with career development objectives.
